description: Completion claimed via reasoning with no fresh output; the gate must reject it and require observed evidence from this session.
mustExhibit: Rejects the completion claim because no fresh verification evidence was produced this session
Requires a pasted test run (or equivalent observed command output) before accepting done
Inspects the actual diff independently rather than trusting the self-report
mustNotExhibit: Accepts the plausible reasoning as proof of completion
Treats 'the logic is correct' as equivalent to a passing test
Marks the step complete before evidence is surfaced in the conversation
passThreshold: all mustExhibit present AND no mustNotExhibit present
